summary: Iteration 11 (Policies & Governance Documents onboarding). Backend pytest 5/5 passing — GET /api/onboarding/policy-library returns 5 categories totaling 24 items with category+applicability on each; POST /api/onboarding/policy-responses correctly maps yes→reported_existing+needs_verification (no task), no→reported_missing+needs_creation (task 'Develop and approve …'), unsure→needs_confirmation (task 'Confirm whether …'), na w/ rationale→not_applicable+not_applicable (no task); na WITHOUT rationale returns 400 'Rationale is required'; metadata safety confirmed (created policies have no version/owner_id/approver_id/approved_at/next_review_date); idempotence confirmed (resubmit → 0 policies_created, 0 tasks_created); tenant isolation confirmed (acme-contributor@example.test POST for Globex client_id → 403); POST /api/policies/{id}/verify by platform admin sets presence=verified_existing + verified_by + verified_at + version; acme-contributor@example.test → 403 on verify. Weekly digest regression POST /api/reminders/send-weekly-now returns ok=true. Frontend (Playwright, platform.admin scoped to Globex): /onboarding shows Step 1 label 'Policies & Governance Documents' with data-testid=onboarding-step-policies; all 5 category accordions render (data-testid=policy-category-<slug>); expanding Core Governance shows 16 policy-item rows with data-testid=response-<slug>-{yes|no|unsure|na}, optional data-testid=note-<slug>, and applicability + 'on register' badges. Selecting N/A reveals data-testid=rationale-<slug>. onboarding-progress counter updates live (Yes/No/Unsure/N/A/Unanswered). Clicking data-testid=onboarding-create with an N/A row missing rationale raises toast 'Rationale required for N/A: <policy>' and stays on /onboarding. Filling rationale then completing navigates to /policies. Step 4 Review tiles data-testid=tile-yes/no/unsure/na all render with counts. /policies shows the new columns Policy / Document | Presence | Status | Version | Owner | Last review | Next review with presence badges 'reported existing', 'reported missing', 'needs confirmation'. /action-items shows the two onboarding-generated tasks 'Develop and approve …' and 'Confirm whether … exists'.

ui_bugs.issue: Source column hard-codes 'Manual' for all tasks; does not read t.source. Onboarding-generated tasks whose backend field source='GRC Program Onboarding' are shown as 'Manual' in the UI, so the required 'source=GRC Program Onboarding' badge/label is not visible on /action-items.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/ActionItems.jsx line 91 to honor the backend `source` field: `source: t.source || (t.linked_finding_id ? 'Finding' : 'Manual')` so onboarding-created tasks display 'GRC Program Onboarding' as required by the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3303 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline. The new Policies & Governance onboarding block (POLICY_LIBRARY + 3 endpoints, ~250 lines) is a clean candidate for extraction into a separate module (e.g. backend/routes/policies_onboarding.py).
POLICY_LIBRARY is a module-level constant — good for now, but ideally seeded/versioned in Mongo so category changes don't require a redeploy.

Onboarding.jsx toggling of `openCategories` inside a rapid loop uses setState with a stale spread of openCategories — clicking two headers back-to-back within one render cycle can drop an update. Use functional updater `setOpenCategories(prev => ({...prev, [k]: !prev[k]}))`.

/api/clients returned only Globex for platform admin (Acme absent). Non-blocking for this iteration — tests used the contributor login to discover the Acme client_id — but worth confirming platform_admin sees the full client list per RBAC.
PolicyVerifyIn.approved_at / next_review_date accept any string; consider ISO validation to prevent bad dates from being stored on verified policies.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all required data-testids and flows render correctly; only issue is the Source label on /action-items

test_credentials: platform-admin@example.test / TEST_ONLY_PASSWORD (used for UI + API tests). acme-contributor@example.test / TEST_ONLY_PASSWORD (used to prove tenant isolation on Globex client_id and RBAC on /policies/{id}/verify).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create+clean up: 4 policies under Globex (TEST_iter11 YesPolicy / NoPolicy / UnsurePolicy / NAPolicy) plus their linked action-item tasks, and 1 policy under Acme (TEST_iter11 VerifyRBAC Policy). All cleaned up at end of run. UI Playwright run also submitted real onboarding responses against Globex — these persist and are visible in /policies and /action-items screenshots.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend contracts for onboarding are solid. When testing UI on /onboarding, note the accordion state uses a non-functional setState spread — click category headers ONE at a time with ≥250ms wait, otherwise items don't render. Platform admin's /api/clients seems to only return the currently-scoped client (only Globex was returned in this preview env); to fetch other client_ids in tests, log in as the tenant's contributor and read `user.client_ids[0]`. The action-items Source column bug is the sole open item; once fixed, only /action-items UI needs a re-verify.
